outline: In this course you will learn how to become familiar with and apply modern computational methods to solve problems in fluid dynamics.
schedule:
Week 01 CFD basics and ANSYS Fluent Introduction
Week 02 Review of Numerical Analysis
Week 03 Governing Equations
Week 04 Governing Equations
Week 05 Basics of Numerical Methods
Week 06 Basics of Numerical Methods
Week 07 Numerical Methods for Advection and Wave Equations
Week 08 Numerical Methods for Advection and Wave Equations
Week 09 Midterm Project
Week 10 Numerical Methods for Burgers Equations
Week 11 Numerical Methods for Burgers Equations
Week 12 Numerical Methods for Burgers Equations
Week 13 Numerical Methods for Euler Equations
Week 14 Numerical Methods for Euler Equations
Week 15 Numerical Methods for Euler Equations
Week 16 Numerical Methods for Navier-Stokes Equations
Week 17 Numerical Methods for Navier-Stokes Equations
Week 18 Final Project
assessment:
Attendance  20%
Homework  40%
Midterm Project  20%
Final Project  20%
